title: Bounce Tales 2.0.3 verified static sprite atlas and animation timing catalogue
source: Original 240x320 JAR 2.0.3, resource index /a, image data /b, decompiled o.java and g.java

dynamic_sprite_table.status: separate payload-specific encoding, not the 7-byte static descriptor table
dynamic_sprite_table.note: Dynamic IDs >=326 can use composite/payload-specific sprite records and are not flattened into the static table.

duration_opcodes.6: signed 16-bit duration at bytes 3..4; countdown subtracts elapsed milliseconds
duration_opcodes.16: signed 32-bit duration at bytes 15..18; timed translation
duration_opcodes.17: signed 32-bit duration at bytes 11..14; timed transform/interpolation

timing_basis.qualification: These are timed animation-script command durations in milliseconds, not a universal per-sprite display frame rate.
